findings.detail: Description of "list_companies" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_companies, list_alert_rules, list_support_requests, get_share_link, create_share_link, create_support_request · Private data: list_companies, track_shipment, update_shipment_identifiers, refresh_shipment, get_share_link, create_share_link, create_support_request, archive_shipment · Public sink: list_companies, list_shipments, list_shared_shipments, list_alert_rules, get_share_link, create_share_link, create_support_request · Destructive: update_shipment_identifiers, archive_shipment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_companies, list_alert_rules, list_support_requests, get_share_link, create_share_link, create_support_request · Private data: list_companies, track_shipment, update_shipment_identifiers, refresh_shipment, get_share_link, create_share_link, create_support_request, archive_shipment · Public sink: list_companies, list_shipments, list_shared_shipments, list_alert_rules, get_share_link, create_share_link, create_support_request · Destructive: update_shipment_identifiers, archive_shipment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
